note: Dated comparisons of our sources with outside witnesses. Evidence only: nothing here changes a gate result or certifies a source as complete. Read by tools/guardian.mjs. Numbers are copied from the named reports in the Project; add an entry when a new comparison is done.

evidence.method: Share of the 6-word runs of our chapter found in CCEL's chapter; a chapter was replaced or re-bounded only if at least 97% matched (both directions for boundaries).
evidence.scope: Chapter level: Genesis, Joshua, Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel, Daniel, the Minor Prophets, John, Romans to Jude.
evidence.result: 31 truncated chapters restored; 286 chapters re-bounded; 136 chapters left alone (Isaiah 1-66 and Acts 1-28 among them).
evidence.limitations: A witness, not a master copy. A percentage of the witness text found in ours does not show that passages are in the right order, that extra text in ours is legitimate, or that every translation is present. Isaiah and Acts chapter divisions were not mapped.

evidence.method: Share of CCEL's commentary text (8-word runs, footnotes, fronts, back matter and indexes excluded) found in our Exodus to Deuteronomy.
evidence.scope: Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, whole books.
evidence.result: Ours 718,921 words; 99.35% of CCEL's commentary text found in ours; no section below 97%.
evidence.limitations: A witness, not a master copy. A percentage of the witness text found in ours does not show that passages are in the right order, that extra text in ours is legitimate, or that every translation is present.
